---
title: "DK1 day ahead electricity price"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: [cosmo, theme.scss]
    embed-resources: true
    nav-buttons:
      - icon: github
        href: https://github.com/jacobazu/dk1-price-forecasting
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
        <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
source("R/battery.R")
source("R/postprocess.R")
source("R/forecasts.R")   # add_ensembles()

Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")   # English day and month names, also on a Danish computer

orange <- "#f97316"
grey   <- "#6b7280"
ink    <- "#1f2328"

# actual prices in DK time
actual <- readRDS("data/processed/prices_dk1_hourly.rds") |>
  mutate(local = with_tz(time, "Europe/Copenhagen"),
         date  = as_date(local),
         hour  = hour(local)) |>
  group_by(date, hour) |>
  summarise(actual = mean(price), .groups = "drop")

# live forecasts
fc <- read_csv("forecasts/forecasts_live.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(date = as_date(date))

latest    <- max(fc$date)
tomorrow  <- fc |> filter(date == latest)
today_act <- actual |> filter(date == latest - 1)
week_act  <- actual |> filter(date == latest - 7)   # same weekday as the forecast day
made_utc  <- tomorrow$forecast_made_utc[1]                # read_csv may already parse it
if (is.character(made_utc)) made_utc <- ymd_hm(made_utc, tz = "UTC")
made_dk   <- with_tz(made_utc, "Europe/Copenhagen")

# scored live forecasts (last 30 days)
scored <- fc |>
  inner_join(actual, by = c("date", "hour")) |>
  filter(date >= max(date) - 29)

eur  <- function(x) format(round(x, 1), nsmall = 1)

hour_label <- function(h) sprintf("%02d:00", h)
has_scores <- nrow(scored) > 0
mae <- function(col) {
  if (!has_scores || !col %in% names(scored)) return("\u2013")
  s <- scored[!is.na(scored[[col]]), ]
  if (nrow(s) == 0) "\u2013" else eur(mean(abs(s$actual - s[[col]])))
}

# Models: a button appears automatically for every model column in forecasts_live.csv.
# To add a model later, add its column name, label and colour here.
# the -X models, their ensemble and the weekly naive benchmark
spot_labels <- c(ensemble  = "Ensemble",
                 bmtx      = "BMT-X",
                 learx     = "LEAR-X",
                 xgbx      = "XGBoost-X",
                 naive_mix = "Naive")
# earlier models, only shown for a day that has no forecast from the models above (12 oct 2026)
old_labels  <- c(lear = "LEAR", bmt = "BMT", xgb = "XGBoost")
model_colors <- c(ensemble  = "#f97316",
                  bmtx      = "#7c3aed",
                  learx     = "#0ea5e9",
                  xgbx      = "#16a34a",
                  naive_mix = "#9ca3af",
                  lear      = "#c2410c",
                  bmt       = "#2563eb",
                  xgb       = "#65a30d")
has_spot <- any(sapply(setdiff(names(spot_labels), "naive_mix"),
                       \(m) m %in% names(tomorrow) && !all(is.na(tomorrow[[m]]))))
model_labels <- if (has_spot) spot_labels else c(spot_labels, old_labels)
models <- intersect(names(model_labels), names(fc))

# buttons above a chart: one per model plus "All", actual prices are always shown
# html buttons instead of plotly's own, so they can be styled in theme.scss
# per_model = traces per model (band + line), "All" shows only the lines
model_buttons <- function(p, models, n_fixed = 1, per_model = 1) {
  vis <- c(lapply(models, \(m) c(rep(TRUE, n_fixed), rep(models == m, each = per_model))),
           list(c(rep(TRUE, n_fixed), rep(c(rep(FALSE, per_model - 1), TRUE), length(models)))))
  htmlwidgets::onRender(p, "
    function(el, x, data) {
      el.style.position = 'relative';
      var bar = document.createElement('div');
      bar.className = 'model-buttons';
      data.labels.forEach(function(lab, i) {
        var b = document.createElement('button');
        b.textContent = lab;
        if (i === 0) b.className = 'active';
        b.onclick = function() {
          Plotly.restyle(el, {visible: data.visible[i]});
          bar.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(o) { o.className = ''; });
          b.className = 'active';
        };
        bar.appendChild(b);
      });
      el.appendChild(bar);
    }",
    data = list(labels = c(unname(model_labels[models]), "All"), visible = vis))
}

chart_layout <- function(p, models = NULL, xtitle = "", n_fixed = 1, per_model = 1) {
  p <- p |>
    layout(paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
           plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
           font = list(family = "Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif", color = grey),
           xaxis = list(title = xtitle, showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, color = grey,
                        linecolor = "#e5ddd3"),
           yaxis = list(title = "", color = grey, gridcolor = "#f1ebe4",
                        zerolinecolor = "#cfc6bb"),
           legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.15, font = list(color = ink)),
           hovermode = "x unified",
           hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "#ffffff", bordercolor = "#efe6dc",
                             font = list(color = ink)),
           margin = list(t = 50)) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
  if (length(models) > 0) p <- model_buttons(p, models, n_fixed, per_model)
  p
}

# results from the backtest scripts (results/*.csv), nothing on the dashboard is typed in by hand
read_res <- function(f) if (file.exists(f)) read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
eval_acc   <- read_res("results/eval_accuracy.csv")    # 10_evaluate.R
eval_tests <- read_res("results/eval_tests.csv")
eval_bias  <- read_res("results/eval_bias.csv")
eval_shape <- read_res("results/eval_shape.csv")
eval_post  <- read_res("results/eval_post.csv")
backtest   <- read_res("results/backtest_forecasts.csv")
if (!is.null(backtest)) backtest <- add_ensembles(backtest)
bmt_sel    <- read_res("results/bmt_selection.csv")    # 06_bmt.R
bmtx_combo <- read_res("results/bmtx_combos.csv")      # 10_evaluate.R
bmtx_sel   <- read_res("results/bmtx_selection.csv")   # 08_bmtx.R
bat_daily  <- read_res("results/battery_daily.csv")    # 11_battery.R
bat_sum    <- read_res("results/battery_summary.csv")
bat_tests  <- read_res("results/battery_tests.csv")
bat_setup  <- read_res("results/battery_setup.csv")
mcs_models <- read_res("results/mcs_models.csv")       # 10_evaluate.R
xgb_tun    <- read_res("results/xgb_tuning.csv")       # 09_xgb.R
has_eval    <- !is.null(eval_acc)
has_battery <- !is.null(bat_sum)

long_labels <- c(perfect = "Perfect foresight",
                 ensemble = "Ensemble (BMT-X, LEAR-X, XGBoost-X)",
                 bmtx = "BMT-X", learx = "LEAR-X", xgbx = "XGBoost-X",
                 naive_mix = "Naive (weekly mix)", lear = "LEAR", bmt = "BMT", xgb = "XGBoost")
text_labels <- c(perfect = "perfect foresight", ensemble = "the ensemble",
                 bmtx = "BMT-X", learx = "LEAR-X", xgbx = "XGBoost-X", naive_mix = "the weekly naive",
                 lear = "LEAR", bmt = "BMT", xgb = "XGBoost")
strat_colors <- c(perfect = "#cfc6bb", model_colors)

cap      <- function(x) paste0(toupper(substring(x, 1, 1)), substring(x, 2))
pct      <- function(x) paste0(format(round(100 * x, 1), nsmall = 1), "%")
eur_sign <- function(x) paste0(if (x >= 0) "+" else "\u2212", prettyNum(abs(round(x)), big.mark = ","))
p_txt    <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste("p =", format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3))
p_tab    <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3))

# main model: lowest backtest mae among the real models that have a forecast for tomorrow
real_models <- setdiff(models, "naive_mix")
avail <- real_models[sapply(real_models, \(m) !all(is.na(tomorrow[[m]])))]
main  <- if (has_eval) {
  ranked <- eval_acc$model[eval_acc$model %in% avail]
  if (length(ranked) > 0) ranked[1] else avail[1]
} else avail[1]
main_label <- model_labels[[main]]

# accuracy tile: the shown model vs the weekly naive
best_all   <- if (has_eval) eval_acc$model[!grepl("^naive", eval_acc$model)][1] else NA
# the shown model, or the best model when the shown one is an earlier model without evaluation
best_bt    <- if (has_eval && main %in% eval_acc$model) main else best_all
bt_improve <- if (!is.na(best_bt)) paste0("\u2212", round(100 * (1 - eval_acc$rmae[eval_acc$model == best_bt])), "%") else "\u2013"
bt_label   <- if (is.na(best_bt)) "" else if (best_bt == main) cap(sub("^the ", "", text_labels[[best_bt]])) else
  paste(cap(sub("^the ", "", text_labels[[best_bt]])), "(from the next forecast)")
live_txt   <- if (has_eval && !has_spot) {
  sprintf("The forecast shown for %s is from %s, an earlier model, because it was saved before the -X models ran live.",
          format(latest, "%a %d %b"), text_labels[[main]])
} else ""

# tests: find a row for two models in either order
find_test <- function(tab, a, b) {
  r <- tab[(tab$model_a == a & tab$model_b == b) | (tab$model_a == b & tab$model_b == a), ]
  if (nrow(r) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (r$model_a != a) {   # flip so the numbers are for a vs b
    for (col in intersect(c("mae_diff", "mean_eur_per_day", "dm_stat", "dm_sq_stat", "t"), names(r))) r[[col]] <- -r[[col]]
    if ("hours_a_better" %in% names(r)) r[c("hours_a_better", "hours_b_better")] <- r[c("hours_b_better", "hours_a_better")]
  }
  r
}

# accuracy text
acc_txt <- if (has_eval) {
  naive_best <- eval_acc$model[grepl("^naive", eval_acc$model)][1]
  real <- eval_acc |> filter(!grepl("^naive", model))
  imp  <- round(100 * (1 - real$mae[1] / eval_acc$mae[eval_acc$model == naive_best]))
  sprintf("%s cuts the average error by %d%% compared with the naive benchmark (%s).",
          long_labels[[real$model[1]]], imp, text_labels[[naive_best]])
} else ""

sig_txt <- if (has_eval && nrow(filter(eval_acc, !grepl("^naive", model))) >= 2) {
  top <- eval_acc$model[!grepl("^naive", eval_acc$model)][1:2]
  r   <- find_test(eval_tests, top[1], top[2])
  if (r$dm_p < 0.05 && r$gw_p < 0.05) {
    sprintf("%s is significantly more accurate than %s (DM %s, GW %s), better in %d and worse in %d of the 24 hours.",
            long_labels[[top[1]]], long_labels[[top[2]]], p_txt(r$dm_p), p_txt(r$gw_p),
            r$hours_a_better, r$hours_b_better)
  } else {
    sprintf("%s has the lower MAE, but the difference to %s is not clearly significant (DM %s, GW %s).",
            long_labels[[top[1]]], long_labels[[top[2]]], p_txt(r$dm_p), p_txt(r$gw_p))
  }
} else ""

# bias correction and band results (10_evaluate.R)
post_txt <- if (!is.null(eval_post) && main %in% eval_post$model) {
  r <- eval_post[eval_post$model == main, ]
  n_sig <- sum(eval_post$dm_p < 0.05 & eval_post$mae_corr < eval_post$mae_raw)
  sprintf(paste("Bias correction (median error of the last %d days): %s mean error %+.1f to %+.1f, MAE %.1f to %.1f (DM %s);",
                "significant for %d of %d models, so not used live. 80%% band (scaled by last week's volatility): covers %s of hours."),
          k_bias, text_labels[[main]], r$mean_error_raw, r$mean_error_corr, r$mae_raw, r$mae_corr, p_txt(r$dm_p),
          n_sig, nrow(eval_post), pct(r$coverage))
} else ""

xgb_txt <- if (!is.null(xgb_tun) && any(xgb_tun$chosen)) {
  ch <- xgb_tun[xgb_tun$chosen, ]
  set_txt <- function(m) { r <- ch[ch$model == m, ]; sprintf("depth %d and %s rounds", r$max_depth, r$rounds) }
  sprintf("Chosen: %s.", set_txt("xgbx"))
} else ""

bmt_avg_sel <- if (!is.null(bmt_sel)) format(round(sum(bmt_sel$share) / n_distinct(bmt_sel$target), 1), nsmall = 1) else "\u2013"
bmt_n_cand  <- if (!is.null(bmt_sel)) n_distinct(bmt_sel$input) else "\u2013"
eval_period <- if (has_eval) {
  n_live <- if ("n_live_days" %in% names(eval_acc)) eval_acc$n_live_days[1] else 0
  sprintf("%s to %s, %d days (%s), %s hourly forecasts",
          format(eval_acc$from[1], "%d %b %Y"), format(eval_acc$to[1], "%d %b %Y"), eval_acc$n_days[1],
          if (n_live > 0) sprintf("%d backtest days, then %d live %s", eval_acc$n_backtest_days[1], n_live,
                                  if (n_live == 1) "day" else "days")
          else "backtest only, live days are added once every model has a saved forecast",
          prettyNum(eval_acc$n_hours[1], big.mark = ","))
} else ""

# BMT-X combinations (variables tab)
has_bmtx  <- !is.null(bmtx_combo)
group_txt <- c(nb = "neighbour prices", wind = "wind", solar = "solar", hol = "holidays")
combo_txt <- function(combo) {
  if (combo == "prices") return("DK1 prices only")
  paste("DK1 prices +", paste(group_txt[strsplit(combo, "+", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]], collapse = " + "))
}
bmtx_txt <- if (has_bmtx) {
  best  <- bmtx_combo[1, ]
  base  <- bmtx_combo[bmtx_combo$combo == "prices", ]
  live  <- bmtx_combo[bmtx_combo$combo == "nb+hol", ]
  n_in  <- sum(bmtx_combo$in_mcs)
  ws    <- grepl("wind|solar", bmtx_combo$combo)
  paste0(
    "The best combination is ", combo_txt(best$combo), " with MAE ", format(round(best$mae, 1), nsmall = 1),
    sprintf(" (%s%.1f vs DK1 prices only). ", if (best$mae <= base$mae) "\u2212" else "+", abs(best$mae - base$mae)),
    n_in, " of the ", nrow(bmtx_combo), " combinations are in the 10% model confidence set",
    if (all(bmtx_combo$in_mcs == ws)) ", exactly the ones with wind or solar. " else ". ",
    "But the wind and solar day-ahead forecasts are published at 18:00 the day before delivery, after the noon auction, ",
    "so those combinations could not have been used for a real bid; they show what that information is worth. ",
    sprintf("With only what is known before the auction (neighbour prices and holidays) the MAE is %.1f, vs %.1f for DK1 prices only.",
            live$mae, base$mae))
} else ""

# battery
bat_val <- function(strategy, col) bat_sum[[col]][bat_sum$strategy == strategy]
bat_set <- function(name) bat_setup$value[bat_setup$name == name]
bat_best <- if (has_battery) bat_sum$strategy[!bat_sum$strategy %in% c("perfect", "naive_mix")][1] else NA
bat_best_label <- if (has_battery) cap(sub("^the ", "", text_labels[[bat_best]])) else ""
bat_share <- if (has_battery) pct(bat_val(bat_best, "share_of_perfect")) else "\u2013"
bat_extra <- if (has_battery) eur_sign(bat_val(bat_best, "eur_per_mw_year") - bat_val("naive_mix", "eur_per_mw_year")) else "\u2013"
bat_p     <- if (has_battery) p_txt(find_test(bat_tests, bat_best, "naive_mix")$p_value) else "\u2013"
bat_days  <- if (has_battery) nrow(bat_daily) else 0
bat_live  <- if (has_battery && "source" %in% names(bat_daily)) sum(bat_daily$source == "live") else 0
bat_period <- if (bat_live > 0) sprintf("%d backtest days, then %d live %s", bat_days - bat_live, bat_live,
                                        if (bat_live == 1) "day" else "days") else sprintf("%d backtest days", bat_days)

# battery text that follows the results
bat_cmp <- function(a, b) {
  r <- find_test(bat_tests, a, b)
  if (is.null(r)) return("")
  if (r$p_value < 0.05) {
    sprintf("%s earns significantly %s than %s (%s).", text_labels[[a]],
            if (r$mean_eur_per_day > 0) "more" else "less", text_labels[[b]], p_txt(r$p_value))
  } else {
    sprintf("%s and %s are not significantly different in profit (%s).",
            text_labels[[a]], text_labels[[b]], p_txt(r$p_value))
  }
}
# money vs accuracy for two forecasts
bat_rank <- function(a, b) {
  more_acc   <- bat_val(a, "mae") < bat_val(b, "mae")
  more_money <- bat_val(a, "total_eur") > bat_val(b, "total_eur")
  la <- text_labels[[a]]; lb <- text_labels[[b]]
  if (more_acc == more_money) {
    w <- if (more_acc) la else lb
    sprintf("%s is both more accurate and earns more.", w)
  } else {
    acc <- if (more_acc) la else lb
    mon <- if (more_money) la else lb
    sprintf("%s has the lower MAE, but %s earns more, since a battery only needs the shape of the day, not the level.", acc, mon)
  }
}
bat_txt <- if (has_battery) {
  real <- bat_sum$strategy[!bat_sum$strategy %in% c("perfect", "naive_mix")]   # by profit
  parts <- bat_cmp(bat_best, "naive_mix")
  if (length(real) >= 2) parts <- c(parts, bat_cmp(real[1], real[2]), bat_rank(real[1], real[2]))
  parts <- parts[parts != ""]
  paste(paste0(toupper(substring(parts, 1, 1)), substring(parts, 2)), collapse = " ")
} else ""

# 80% band for tomorrow from each model's errors on the days before (R/postprocess.R)
vol_now <- vol_scale(bind_rows(actual, if (!is.null(backtest)) select(backtest, date, hour, actual)),
                     seq(latest - k_int - 1, latest, by = "day"))
past_errors <- function(m) {
  bt <- if (!is.null(backtest) && m %in% names(backtest)) select(backtest, date, hour, actual, f = all_of(m)) else NULL
  lv <- if (m %in% names(fc)) fc |> filter(date < latest, !is.na(.data[[m]])) |>
    select(date, hour, f = all_of(m)) |> inner_join(actual, by = c("date", "hour")) else NULL
  bind_rows(lv, bt) |>
    distinct(date, hour, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    transmute(date, hour, e = actual - f) |>
    left_join(vol_now, by = "date")
}
bands <- lapply(setNames(models, models), \(m) {
  b <- adjust_day(past_errors(m), latest, vol_now$s[vol_now$date == latest])
  if (is.null(b)) return(NULL)
  tomorrow |> select(hour, f = all_of(m)) |> inner_join(b, by = "hour") |>
    mutate(lower = f + lo_s, upper = f + hi_s)
})
band_cov <- function(m) if (!is.null(eval_post) && m %in% eval_post$model) eval_post$coverage[eval_post$model == m] else NA
rgba <- function(hex, a) { v <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex); sprintf("rgba(%d,%d,%d,%.2f)", v[1], v[2], v[3], a) }

# forecast tiles, from the main model
diff_today <- mean(tomorrow[[main]]) - mean(today_act$actual)
diff_html  <- if (is.na(diff_today)) "" else
  sprintf('<span class="%s">%s%s</span> vs %s',
          if (diff_today > 0) "kpi-up" else "kpi-down",
          if (diff_today > 0) "+" else "\u2212", eur(abs(diff_today)), format(latest - 1, "%a %d %b"))
cheap <- tomorrow[which.min(tomorrow[[main]]), ]
peak  <- tomorrow[which.max(tomorrow[[main]]), ]

# live battery profit: same battery, planned with the saved live forecasts, paid the actual prices
lp_def   <- battery_lp(if (has_battery) as.list(setNames(bat_setup$value, bat_setup$name)) else battery_setup)
live_days <- scored |> group_by(date) |> filter(n() == 24) |> ungroup()
live_bat <- if (nrow(live_days) > 0) {
  live_days |>
    arrange(date, hour) |>
    group_by(date) |>
    group_modify(\(x, k) {
      cols <- c("actual", models[sapply(models, \(m) !anyNA(x[[m]]))])
      tibble(strategy = cols, profit = sapply(cols, \(m) battery_profit(x[[m]], x$actual, lp_def)))
    }) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(strategy = if_else(strategy == "actual", "perfect", strategy))
} else NULL
live_bat_days <- if (is.null(live_bat)) 0 else n_distinct(live_bat$date)
live_share <- "\u2013"
live_sub   <- "starts after the first forecast day"
if (live_bat_days > 0 && main %in% live_bat$strategy) {
  x <- live_bat |> group_by(strategy) |> summarise(profit = sum(profit), days = n())
  live_share <- pct(x$profit[x$strategy == main] / x$profit[x$strategy == "perfect"])
  live_sub   <- sprintf("%d %s with a saved forecast", x$days[x$strategy == main],
                        if (x$days[x$strategy == main] == 1) "day" else "days")
}

bat_desc <- if (has_battery) sprintf("%g MWh / %g MW battery, %g%% round trip efficiency, max %g full cycle per day",
                                     bat_set("cap_mwh"), bat_set("power_mw"),
                                     100 * bat_set("eff_rt"), bat_set("max_cycle")) else ""
```

## Row {height=86%}

```{r}
#| title: "Forecast for the next delivery day, with recent actual prices (EUR/MWh)"
p <- plot_ly() |>
  add_lines(data = today_act, x = ~hour, y = ~actual,
            name = paste("Actual", format(latest - 1, "%a %d %b"), "(day before)"),
            line = list(color = grey, width = 2, dash = "dot"),
            hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>", format(latest - 1, "%a %d %b"), "</extra>")) |>
  add_lines(data = week_act, x = ~hour, y = ~actual,
            name = paste("Actual", format(latest - 7, "%a %d %b"), "(same weekday last week)"),
            line = list(color = "#cfc6bb", width = 2, dash = "dash"),
            hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>", format(latest - 7, "%a %d %b"), "</extra>"))

# the naive is left out here: its forecast is one of the two actual lines (last week on mon, sat, sun)
fc_models <- setdiff(models, "naive_mix")
fc_models <- c(main, setdiff(fc_models, main))   # chart opens on the same model as the tiles

for (m in fc_models) {
  b <- bands[[m]]
  if (is.null(b)) b <- tibble(hour = 0:23, lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_)
  cov_txt <- if (is.na(band_cov(m))) "" else sprintf(", covered %s of hours so far", pct(band_cov(m)))
  p <- p |>
    add_lines(data = b, x = ~hour, y = ~lower, line = list(width = 0), showlegend = FALSE,
              visible = (m == fc_models[1]), hoverinfo = "skip") |>
    add_lines(data = b, x = ~hour, y = ~upper, line = list(width = 0), fill = "tonexty",
              fillcolor = rgba(model_colors[[m]], 0.15),
              name = paste0("80% band from the last ", k_int, " days' errors, scaled by last week's volatility", cov_txt),
              visible = (m == fc_models[1]), hoverinfo = "skip") |>
    add_lines(data = tomorrow, x = ~hour, y = tomorrow[[m]],
              name = paste0(model_labels[[m]], " forecast ", format(latest, "%a %d %b"),
                            ", made ", format(made_dk, "%a %d %b %H:%M")),
              visible = (m == fc_models[1]),
              line = list(color = model_colors[[m]], width = 3),
              hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>", model_labels[[m]], "</extra>"))
}

p |> chart_layout(fc_models, xtitle = "Hour (Danish time)", n_fixed = 2, per_model = 3) |> layout(xaxis = list(dtick = 3))
```

# Variables

## Row {height=100%}

::: {.card title="Which variables help? Tick the groups to add"}

DK1 prices from D-1, D-2, D-3 and D-7 are always candidates. Each ticked group adds candidates,
and BMT picks from all of them. Results are from the backtest; every combination is precomputed.

```{r}
if (has_bmtx) {
  dat <- bmtx_combo |>
    left_join(bmtx_sel, by = "combo") |>
    mutate(rank = row_number(), label = sapply(combo, combo_txt)) |>
    select(combo, label, rank, mae, rmse, rmae, mcs_p, in_mcs,
           n_sel, n_prices, n_nb, n_wind, n_solar, n_hol)
  base_mae <- dat$mae[dat$combo == "prices"]
  htmltools::HTML(paste0('
<div class="group-picker">
  <label><input type="checkbox" value="nb"> Neighbour prices <small>DE, DK2, NO2, SE3, SE4, yesterday</small></label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" value="wind"> Wind <small>forecast for tomorrow, published after the auction</small></label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" value="solar"> Solar <small>forecast for tomorrow, published after the auction</small></label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" value="hol"> Holidays <small>tomorrow and today</small></label>
</div>
<div id="combo-result" class="combo-result"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var data = ', jsonlite::toJSON(dat, dataframe = "rows", digits = 4), ';
  var base = ', base_mae, ';
  var n = data.length;
  var order = ["nb", "wind", "solar", "hol"];
  function key() {
    var on = order.filter(function(g) {
      return document.querySelector(".group-picker input[value=" + g + "]").checked;
    });
    return on.length ? on.join("+") : "prices";
  }
  function f(x, d) { return Number(x).toFixed(d); }
  function render() {
    var r = data.find(function(x) { return x.combo === key(); });
    var diff = r.mae - base;
    var mcs = r.in_mcs
      ? "<span class=\'tag good\'>in the model confidence set</span> (p = " + f(r.mcs_p, 2) + ")"
      : "<span class=\'tag\'>not in the model confidence set</span> (p = " + f(r.mcs_p, 3) + ")";
    document.getElementById("combo-result").innerHTML =
      "<div class=\'combo-name\'>" + r.label + "</div>" +
      "<div class=\'combo-stats\'>" +
      "<div><span>MAE</span><b>" + f(r.mae, 1) + "</b><small>" +
        (r.combo === "prices" ? "baseline" : (diff <= 0 ? "\u2212" : "+") + f(Math.abs(diff), 1) + " vs prices only") + "</small></div>" +
      "<div><span>RMSE</span><b>" + f(r.rmse, 1) + "</b><small>\u20ac/MWh</small></div>" +
      "<div><span>Rank</span><b>" + r.rank + " / " + n + "</b><small>by MAE</small></div>" +
      "</div>" +
      "<p>" + mcs + "</p>" +
      "<p>BMT picks on average " + f(r.n_sel, 1) + " variables per hour: " +
      f(r.n_prices, 1) + " DK1 prices" +
      (r.n_nb > 0 || key().indexOf("nb") >= 0 ? ", " + f(r.n_nb, 1) + " neighbour prices" : "") +
      (r.n_wind > 0 || key().indexOf("wind") >= 0 ? ", " + f(r.n_wind, 1) + " wind" : "") +
      (r.n_solar > 0 || key().indexOf("solar") >= 0 ? ", " + f(r.n_solar, 1) + " solar" : "") +
      (r.n_hol > 0 || key().indexOf("hol") >= 0 ? ", " + f(r.n_hol, 1) + " holiday" : "") + ".</p>";
  }
  document.querySelectorAll(".group-picker input").forEach(function(i) {
    i.addEventListener("change", render);
  });
  render();
})();
</script>'))
} else {
  cat("Run scripts/08_bmtx.R and 10_evaluate.R to add the BMT-X results.")
}
```

::: {.card title="How it works"}

Each day a `r bat_desc` plans its charging and selling for tomorrow using the forecast,
and is then paid the actual prices. The chart and table cover `r bat_period` (live days are added
once every model has a saved forecast); the live tile uses the forecasts saved before each auction
(`r live_bat_days` days so far). Perfect foresight plans with the actual prices and is the upper bound.

`r bat_txt`

No fees, no battery wear, hourly instead of 15-minute trading.

:::

## Row {height=60%}

::: {.card title="Is the difference significant?"}

Rolling out-of-sample forecasts, `r eval_period`, all models on the same hours.

`r acc_txt` `r sig_txt` `r live_txt`

```{r}
if (has_eval) {
  real_m  <- eval_acc$model[!grepl("^naive", eval_acc$model)]
  naive_b <- eval_acc$model[grepl("^naive", eval_acc$model)][1]
  others <- setdiff(c(real_m, naive_b), real_m[1])
  bind_rows(lapply(others, \(o) mutate(find_test(eval_tests, real_m[1], o), model_a = real_m[1], model_b = o))) |>
    transmute(Comparison    = paste(long_labels[model_a], "vs", long_labels[model_b]),
              `MAE diff`    = round(mae_diff, 2),
              `DM p`        = p_tab(dm_p),
              `GW p`        = p_tab(gw_p),
              `Hours better / worse` = paste(hours_a_better, "/", hours_b_better)) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrrr")
}
```

:::

::: {.card title="How it works"}

**Models.** All use the DK1 prices from D-1, D-2, D-3 and D-7, plus neighbour prices (DE, DK2,
NO2, SE3, SE4) from D-1 and holidays: the extra data known before the noon auction. Wind and solar
day-ahead forecasts are published at 18:00, after the auction, so they are only in the study of all 16
combinations (Variables tab). All are re-estimated every day on the previous two years, on prices
transformed with asinh((p − median) / MAD).

**BMT-X**, boosting with multiple testing (Kapetanios, Sarafidis & Ventouri), the method from my
master's thesis: variables are added one at a time, each the most significant given the ones already
in, until none passes a multiple-testing threshold; then OLS. One model per hour.

**LEAR-X** (after Lago 2021): one LASSO per hour on the same variables, lambda by BIC.

**XGBoost-X**: boosted trees, one model for all hours. Depth and rounds picked on 61 days before the
test period and kept fixed. `r xgb_txt`

**Ensemble:** the plain average of BMT-X, LEAR-X and XGBoost-X.

**Benchmark:** the weekly naive: last week's prices on Mondays, Saturdays and Sundays, yesterday's on
other days. rMAE = MAE relative to it.

**Tests:** best model vs each other model. DM = Diebold-Mariano on the daily average absolute error
(HLN correction), GW = Giacomini-White, hours = how many of the 24 hours it is significantly better /
worse (Holm). The model confidence set (Hansen, Lunde & Nason, 10%, 7-day block bootstrap) keeps the
models that can't be told apart from the best one.

**Bias:** mean error above 0 = too low on average; Mincer-Zarnowitz slope above 1 = moves too little
(MZ p tests intercept 0 and slope 1, Newey-West).

**Live:** each forecast is saved before the noon auction the day before, with the time it was made,
and never changed. After noon nothing is saved.

**Data:** [Energi Data Service](https://www.energidataservice.dk) (Energinet).<br>
**Code:** [github.com/jacobazu/dk1-price-forecasting](https://github.com/jacobazu/dk1-price-forecasting)<br>
**Last updated:** `r format(with_tz(Sys.time(), "Europe/Copenhagen"), "%d %B %Y, %H:%M")` (Danish time)

:::
